R9426.summary: Ferdinand of Bavaria, Elector of Cologne, writes to his brother Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria about quartering and paying the Catholic League's troops in the Rhine-Westphalian circle (Horn, Montfort, Deutz, Lintelo's and Herberstorff's companies, a year's respite for Paderborn), and argues that the common union is needed for the conservation of the Catholic religion. Six weeks after Frederick V's coronation in Prague; nomenclator groups apart from 248 = und are open.

R9425.summary: Archduke Albert's written resolution for the League agent Licentiate Morreus: he agrees on the recovery of the kingdom of Bohemia, has done good offices with the Emperor and the King of Spain, will send troops on foot if needed but cannot grant the muster place, the regiment of foot and the 500 horse, and refers the 1000 cuirassiers to Ambrogio Spinola. Read with the R9426 key unchanged.
